bio: An elephant calf with a glowing tip to its trunk that picks up every signal in town.
Steel tusks like refinery pipes and a crimson tent of a back. It carries a wedding for a thousand guests without noticing.
It carries a house of twenty-seven storeys on its back, with a helipad on top. The house has a floor just for the snow.
note: Its trunk gets five bars anywhere.
Its weddings have a dress code for the elephants.
The house has a floor for the cars.
